conditions: Shopper ticks the 'Pliers' subcategory checkbox in the sidebar filter panel
items.expected: The 'Pliers' checkbox is checked; the product list shows only products in the Pliers category (e.g. 'Combination Pliers', 'Pliers') and products from other categories disappear

conditions: Shopper ticks the 'ForgeFlex Tools' brand checkbox in the sidebar filter panel
items.expected: The 'ForgeFlex Tools' checkbox is checked; the product list shows only products of that brand and products of other brands disappear

conditions: Shopper ticks a category filter then unticks it
items.expected: The checkbox returns to unchecked state; the product list returns to showing the full unfiltered product set (including products from all categories)

conditions: Shopper ticks a category filter, then navigates to page 2 of the filtered results
items.expected: The category checkbox remains checked; the product list on page 2 still shows only products matching the chosen category filter

conditions: axe-core scan of the product list page with filter panel, scoped to the sidebar and product grid, checking WCAG A/AA rules
items.expected: No axe-core violations reported (violations array is empty)

excluded.reason: TOOL-21 is about the admin panel's product search not narrowing the list — it does not touch the shopper-facing category/brand filter panel that this story covers
TOOL-20 is about the billing address step in checkout not being pre-filled from the customer profile — completely unrelated to product filtering
This story is purely about read-only filter UI with no authentication, session or data-protection implications; no security-specific test is warranted
Neither open bug (TOOL-21, TOOL-20) touches this story's behaviour; no confirmation tests are required
